page.overview:
Who is Tim Goodman?

Tim Goodman is the main character from .

Tim has brown hair and black eyes. He wears a red sweater, blue pants, and blue with red sneakers.

Tim Goodman is a compassionate, caring, 18-year-old. He is a driven boy who is determined to help others when the opportunity presents itself.

Tim Goodman is the son of esteemed detective Harry Goodman, who has gone missing prior to the events of Detective Pikachu (video game). After his father's purported death, Tim partners with Detective Pikachu (video game), his father's former partner, who has come looking for Harry as the only clue to his past.
